# 👋 Hi, I'm ningbojian

I focus on Python and TypeScript automation. My projects include github-trending-agent and ProfileReadmeAgent, which handle GitHub trending digests and scheduled profile README updates, respectively; I have also worked on OpenCV/HALCON trajectory processing for a robotic arm and a Django site for Chinese surname culture.
